description: This file defines a 'ProductDetail' component for a furniture shopping app frontend, built using LightningJS framework. It includes template markup, state, watchers, initialization, and methods related to displaying product details and adding items to the cart.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the current product to the shopping cart via AppStore.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, loads products if needed, and sets the selected product based on the component's 'id' prop.
